audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..6].side all read 'Skill' (with generic Sivir-boomerang why text lifted from an unrelated matchup), while content win[0..6] all say Heimerdinger and match the packet levelChart (Heimerdinger 7/7). The two layers directly contradicted each other on every row.
audit.why: packet.levelChart and content.win[]/whys[] consistently describe Heimerdinger's turret nest controlling the entire lane; full layer never mentions a turret at all.
audit.corrected: All 7 phases[].side moved to Heimerdinger with ratings adjusted and why text rewritten to describe the turret/W-rocket zone and E grenade stun, matching content.

audit.why: Content spikes[] already correctly identify the turret/W-rocket zone (lvl 3-5), the UPGRADE!!! + E grenade all-in threat (lvl 6), and the turret DPS scaling into items as the real power spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no real cooldown numbers despite the defect flag, and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.why: packet.defects flags missing cooldown-sequencing advice; lintFindings flags both COPY_PASTE_BLEED entries.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now cites CH-2 Grenade (11s CD), Sivir E (24-18s CD), and R (120/100/80s); dosFull[1].d now describes farming through the turret's 1s beam cycle, and dontsFull[2].d now matches its 'Siege the nest shield-down' title.

edits.before: Q both passes through the contacts — the boomerang bills twice; stand where the return doubles.
edits.after: His H-28G turret (1s CD) drops turn one and controls the lane immediately — any step-up eats turret fire.

edits.before: W-bounce the duo trades: the ricochet taxes his support for standing in formation.
edits.after: His turret and W rockets out-trade your Q — you're pinned farming from max range already.

edits.before: Spell shield games begin: every ability he aims is now a mana refund audition.
edits.after: His turret field zones you off CS entirely, denying every clean trade you try.

edits.before: Shove the metronome: your W clears set the lane's tempo — he farms under tower or fights your timing.
edits.after: Multi-turret setup keeps you pinned through 4-5 — you farm from range while his AP nest does the work.

edits.before: On the Hunt online — the team-speed flips engages both directions; the map plays at your pace.
edits.after: UPGRADE!!! plus his E grenade stun (11s CD) threaten a real all-in — your engage hits a turret wall.

edits.before: First item spike: the ricochet shreds duos and the shove becomes weather.
edits.after: Even at first item his turret DPS still outscales what you force under the nest.

edits.before: Late Sivir conducts: speed the engage, shield the answer, and ricochet the teamfight through its own front line.
edits.after: His turrets still deny space and choke fights — your R and cleave matter more in group fights than the duel.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade (Stun): matchup-defining — The stun makes his turret nest lethal — dodge it before committing anything. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Spell Shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade (Stun, 11s CD): the stun makes his turret nest lethal — dodge it before committing anything. - Your E Spell Shield (24-18s CD) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - Hold the 120/100/80s R for the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: Farm through the turret's 1s beam cycle from max range — step in only when its zone timer is actually down.

edits.before: Spending E on chip damage and eating the engage it existed to eat — the shield is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: You can't out-siege a turret nest at even HP — pull back and let him overextend his own turret field first.

notes: Full-layer level chart was a wholesale Draven/Ezreal template ('boomerang bills twice' etc.) that never mentioned a turret — rewrote all 7 rows to match content, which already correctly described Heimerdinger dominating the whole lane (matches packet levelChart 7/7 Heimerdinger). The 53.27% Sivir winRate in the packet is the overall game win rate, not a lane-stage claim, so it doesn't contradict a lane the data says Heimerdinger wins on the ground. suspectNames flagged wants.you[1] 'Use Spell Shield' as a possible wrong name, but it's correct plain usage of the real ability, not a fabricated name — left alone.
